test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The students / are expected / to come / in the right time.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1. i.e. "in the right time"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"in the right time"** is grammatically **incorrect** in this context.
 
• The **correct expression** should be **"on time,"** which means at the scheduled or proper time.
 
• "In the right time" does not convey a clear meaning in English when discussing punctuality.
 
• The phrases "The students," "are expected," and "to come" do not contain any grammatical errors and are appropriately used in this sentence.

Therefore, the corrected sentence is- *The students are expected to come **on time**.*
